lesson.title: The slow link
lesson.goal: Pings between DeskA and DeskB keep failing. Make both ends of the cable agree on speed and duplex.

step.text: Ping DeskB from DeskA. Some pings are lost even though the cable is fine.
On either computer open Config and read the Speed and Duplex selects. One end is fixed and the other is auto, so the cable runs half duplex.
Set both ends the same (for example 100 and full on both, or auto on both), then ping again.

check.label: DeskA's end has no duplex mismatch
DeskB's end has no duplex mismatch
